verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any export feature, such as CSV or JSON export, a full-workspace data dump, or an offboarding path. The only related evidence is a REST API that returns JSON and endpoints for listing and reading records. That API is a developer building block a user could script into an export, not a documented 'export all data and leave' capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
